For the best experience, use any of these supported browsers: Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge.HomeSportsWrestlingWWE WrestleMania TicketsEventsAboutReviewsFans Also ViewedHappening This WeekShowing slide 1, 2 and 3 of 8No more results on this pageAboutWrestleMania returns to Las Vegas for the second consecutive year as Allegiant Stadium hosts the biggest event of the year over two nights on Saturday, April 18 and Sunday, April 19, 2026! WWE's Las Vegas takeover will feature can't-miss action headlined by its biggest Superstars, including Roman Reigns, CM Punk, Brock Lesnar, Cody Rhodes, Becky Lynch, Charlotte Flair, Rhea Ripley, Jade Cargill and more. Witness your favorite Superstars from Monday Night RAW and Friday Night SmackDown as they take the stage at the Showcase of the Immortals! Ticket purchasers will have an opportunity to purchase a commemorative WrestleMania chair, a commemorative limited edition WrestleMania magnet and souvenir ticket during the purchase process. Don't miss your chance to be a part of history!Rating: 3.5 out of 5 based on 198 reviewsRating: 5 out of 5A great experience in a great stadiumby Ludowwe on 4/27/25Allegiant Stadium - Las VegasIt was impressionnant to see and to be in the beautiful Allegiant StadiumRating: 3 out of 5Expensive but funby Nicole on 4/27/25Allegiant Stadium - Las VegasI’ve always dreamed of experiencing a Wrestlemania. Having travelled from Sydney to Perth for Elimination Chamber in 2024 and then watching Wrestlemania 40 on tv, it really made me want to be there in person for Wrestlemania 41. The ticket prices were very expensive, but I convinced myself it was worth it for a once in a lifetime experience. Traveling from Australia, there were also many other costs involved. I found it was cheaper to book tickets for each night separately rather than the 2 night packages. This also allowed us to spend a bit more on better tickets for one night. I was disappointed to see how much prices dropped in the days leading up to the event. Overall, we had a good time at Wrestlemania but the tickets were so expensive, the cost was always in the back of my mind and I can’t help but feel for the price, there should have been more surprises, excitement, more spectacular entrances, or maybe even a longer show.Rating: 3 out of 5Over pricedby Status on 4/26/25Allegiant Stadium - Las VegasNot the greatest wrestlemania for the ticket prices.
